title: gagea fascicularis
intro: Gagea fascicularis, commonly known as the white gagea or white autumn-flowering gagea, is a flowering plant species belonging to the lily family (Liliaceae). It is used in traditional medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and sore throat. The plant is reported to possess therapeutic actions such as immunomodulatory, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins. Further research is required to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential applications of Gagea fascicularis.
